item.title: ISL 2025-26: Ezzejjari’s Brace Helps East Bengal Overcome NorthEast United
item.description: Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan: A brace of goals within six minutes in the second half by Youssef Ezzejari and an injury-time strike by Miguel Ferreira guided East Bengal FC to a 3-0 win against NorthEast United FC in Match 6 of the Indian Super League (ISL) 2025-26 season, played at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata on Monday.

item.title: Morikawa Ends Title Drought At Pebble Beach Pro-Am As Bhatia Finishes Tied-sixth
item.description: Pebble Beach Pro: Akshay Bhatia, who held a two-shot lead heading into the final round, faltered with a closing 72 to finish tied-sixth, three shots behind the winner at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am golf tournament.

item.title: T20 WC: Santner Unwell, Jamieson Back As Canada Ask NZ To Bowl
item.description: T20 World Cup: Canada won the toss and elected to bat against New Zealand in their Group D match of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup here at the MA Chidambaram Stadium on Tuesday.

item.title: Sinner Off To Winning Start On Doha Debut
item.description: Since Andrey Rublev: Two weeks after his five-set defeat to Novak Djokovic in the semi-finals of the Australian Open, Jannik Sinner returned to winning ways on his Qatar Open debut with a solid 6-1, 6-4 win over Tomas Machac at the hard-court ATP 500 event.

item.title: Pratika Rawal Added To India’s Squad For ODI Series Against Australia
item.description: Cricket World Cup: Pratika Rawal has been added to India's squad for the upcoming three-ODI series in Australia after successfully completing her rehabilitation from injuries, the BCCI said on Tuesday.

item.title: Barcelona Drop Crucial Points After Losing To Girona In Derby
item.description: FC Barcelona: FC Barcelona surrendered top spot in La Liga after a 2-1 defeat to Girona which exposed the defensive fragility that has troubled Hansi Flick's side in recent weeks.

item.title: T20 WC: ‘India Moving In Right Path, Wishing Momentum Continues Till End,’ Says BCCI Secy Devajit Saikia
item.description: T20 World Cup: Team India have made a powerful statement in the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, maintaining an unbeaten run in the group stage and booking their place in the Super 8 stage with one Group A game to spare, and the BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia believes that the Men in Blue are heading "in the right path".

item.title: Hockey India Name 24-member Squad For FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26 Hobart Leg
item.description: FIH Hockey Pro League: Hockey India revealed the 24-member team for the Hobart round of the FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26, set to be held from February 20 to 25 at the Tasmania Hockey Centre in Hobart. This stage of the tournament will feature India, Spain, and the host nation, Australia, ensuring exciting, competitive hockey.

item.title: Women's Rising Star Asia Cup: Spinners Power India To Dominant Win Over Nepal
item.description: Rising Star Asia Cup: India A delivered a commanding performance to defeat Nepal A by seven wickets in the Women’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 here at the Terdthai Cricket Ground.
